name: Melissa & Doug Sunny Patch Happy Giddy Crawl-Through Tunnel
description: Find Playground Structures and Accessories at Target.com! Your children and their friends will love crawling through this fun play tunnel from Melissa and Doug. Create an exclusive amusement park for your baby. name: Swing-N-Slide Playsets Green Apex Wave Slide
description: Just like our ever-popular Alpine Wave Slide, the Swing-N-Slide Apex Wave Slide offers a universal option for backyard fun by attaching to almost all 4 ft. tall play decks. It's the Alpine's younger sibling. It combines speed and waves within a comforting scoop design and compact design for endless entertainment. The durable plastic design features a lifetime warranty against cracking and fading. Made of high-density polyethylene, this slide mounts to 4 ft. deck platforms. Color: Green.
